To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
mixed methods participatory approaches are useful to address social problems in communities.
mixed methods participatory designs can be used to empower individuals, communities and organizations in the pursuit of social change.
mixed methods research can be used to address complex social problems and that the use of multiple methods is not only beneficial for research, but also for the participants of the research.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new paradigm of mixed methods participative research.

the development and implementation of community psychology interventions, and the use of participatory research methods and mixed methods approaches to study the effectiveness and outcomes of these interventions.
the ways in which participatory research designs can contribute to the practice of community psychology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

mixed methods participatory designs have the potential to enhance social science research, and that the three models of mixed participatory research presented in this article provide a framework for the design and implementation of future mixed methods participatory studies in community psychology and beyond.
mixed methods participatory designs have great potential to advance community psychology and to promote social change.
participatory mixed methods research designs are a promising and valuable approach to community research and action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mixed methods participatory approaches can be a powerful means to address social problems in a way that is both rigorous and responsive to community concerns.
participatory research is a powerful approach for community psychologists to engage with communities, organizations, and individuals to promote social change.
mixed methods participatory designs are a powerful way to address social problems and contribute to the development of community psychology as a discipline.
The main takeaway from our work is that
community psychologists should consider using mixed methods participatory designs to address social inequalities and promote social justice.
community psychologists should consider the interplay between research design and participatory approaches in their work.
mixed methods designs can facilitate the integration of participatory approaches and ecological principles in research.
